description: This PHP class 'HolidayDao' is a Data Access Object responsible for managing Holiday entities in the database. It provides methods to add, retrieve, search, and delete holiday records within the OrangeHRM system's leave plugin.

classes.name: HolidayDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for managing Holiday entities in the database. It facilitates CRUD operations and searching with filtering and pagination support.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Persists a Holiday entity to the database, adding or updating it.

methods.name: getHolidayById
methods.description: Retrieves a Holiday entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingHolidayIds
methods.description: Checks for existing holiday IDs in the database from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Searches for holidays based on filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getSearchHolidaysPaginator
methods.description: Configures and returns a paginator object for holiday search results.

methods.name: getHolidayByDate
methods.description: Retrieves a recurring holiday by a specific date.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes holidays from the database given an array of IDs.
